nom: Paula's Choice CLEAR Salicylic Acid Exfoliating Body Acne Spray

segments.oily: The one reviewer who specifies combination/oily skin reports it works well on her back and body, though she noticed a few minor dry patches on her face in colder months.
segments.combination: The reviewer with combination/oily skin uses it on her face as well as her back, applying it only once daily on the face because of its drying effect.
segments.dry: Reviewers caution against using this on dry skin, particularly on the face, since the salicylic acid can dry it out further; one recommends body-only use and moisturizing right after for anyone prone to dryness.
segments.sensitive: The one reviewer who describes her skin as super sensitive, with keratosis pilaris, reports it cleared her body acne and also helped with chicken skin and ingrown hairs.

concerns.dehydration: This spray can dry out skin, especially on the face — several reviewers recommend using it only once daily there, moisturizing right after, and avoiding it altogether on dry skin, while body use is generally described as better tolerated.
concerns.spots: Reports are mixed: several reviewers say dark spots and acne marks fade with continued use, while one reviewer specifically says it works well for active breakouts but does little for the marks left behind.
concerns.blemishes: This is the product's core reported use: most reviewers, including several treating years-long or hormonal back and chest acne, report significant clearing within one to several weeks; however, a minority describe the opposite — a burning reaction and a fresh wave of breakouts, in one case severe enough to require a doctor visit.

aspects.libelle: Spray nozzle weakens or clogs as the bottle empties

Expensive and empties faster than expected

extraits.texte: I had a few pimples on my shoulders and chest. I wanted them to go away. I ordered this based on the reviews. I sprayed it on a total of 3 times before I started getting burning sensation on my skin. Then I broke out in a bunch of time yellow head pimples all over my chest and shoulders. Anywhere I sprayed this. It’s day 3 and it has gone down a little but still terrible. Pictures are day 3 of the reaction. Should’ve taken of day 1 when at its worst.
I bought for my teenage son back. There was so tiny problem before. After used the product this is the result. He has to go to the doctor. He is in depression now.

extraits.titre: NO MORE BREAKOUTS... but will dry out your skin
extraits.texte: I absolutely love this! Even though I am in my late 30's I have hormonal acne, and my back is prone to breaking out around my cycle and after working out. Every morning, I spray this on my back & then on a cotton round to apply to my face and allow to air dry. I only do once a day on my face as it can be very drying, but I will spray my back again after showering after a workout. I have combination/oily skin have noticed some dry patches on my face after using but extremely minimal, and only in the colder months. I wouldn't recommend using if you have dry skin. I had HORRIBLE cystic acne on my back that was painful and horrendous to look at. My dermatologist did prescribe me some wipes that helped greatly with the initial clear up but can be hard for my pharmacy to keep in stock. The auto shipment option with this spray is fantastic and it is eligible for my HSA! I haven't had any major breakouts on my face OR back since using this consistently for the past 3 months. I maybe get 1-2 pimples on my back now, and they clear up within a couple days. Short and sweet recommendations: - do not use on your face if you have dry skin - apply lotion/moisturizer once it has completely dried down - Use a cotton round to apply to face - Only use 1x per day on face due to drying, but can use multiple times per day on back/body. Start with 1 application per day and see how your skin reacts. - Use HSA funds and auto shipment, if available!

extraits.titre: AMAZING✨Back acne cleared up in 1 week!
extraits.texte: First photo is the before. Second photo is 1 week after using the spray about once or twice a day. I have struggled with back acne for years. Buying all kinds of back scrubbers, exfoliating scrubs, acne wash & creams. Nothing helped my hormonal acne except this. Didn’t make my skin worse before it gets better like some acne products do. It cleared up in 1 week. The smell does stink but I could care less cause the product is that AMAZING 🤩 Definitely buying more. Also works for chicken skin & ingrown hairs! I have super sensitive skin and suffer from keratosis pilaris aka chicken skin…Raised tiny bumps. I also have always suffered from horrible, itchy ingrown hairs after shaving on my bikini line and upper legs. I’ve been at war with my skin for most of my life. Buying so many products to help each horrible skin condition I was so graciously blessed with 🥴 Now I only have to buy THIS ONE PRODUCT!!! 👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻 I will always keep this product stocked in my home.

So far so good! I’m seeing results so I’m happy it’s not money wasted on yet another product that doesn’t live up to the hype. Pictures are a month and change apart. I’ll keep using and update review. Pic with the braids is day 1. Other 2 pics are today 18Mar. Darks spots are fading but there’s still ways to go. I also haven’t had any breakouts so that’s a plus.
